description: Permissions of windows created at runtime by slot pop-out (slot-popup-*) — they must be able to use the same IPC surface as the main window (subscribe_output/request_replay/forward_daemon_command/layout queries) to subscribe to and render their own View. core:default (invoke/window) + core:event:default (event listen such as layout:updated). ★The window-close permission (core:window:allow-close) is not granted★ — zero-tab self-closing and window buttons go through the shell invoke (window_control), LLM closing goes through the bus window.close or the same invoke (both the same shell service), and the web does not call the window API (TRD S26-window-chrome §5-4 · §5-5 · §9 · AC10). core:window:allow-start-dragging — window drag from the title-bar drag area (same as main · §7-2). dialog:allow-open — the agent tree slot (agent_list) can also be placed in a popup window (set_slot_content), so the folder picker of that slot menu's 'create agent' must work in popup windows too (minimum permission: open only). The opener permission for usage slot links is granted by usage-links.json to these windows together with main.
